name: powerbi-modeling-mcp
description: Microsoft Power BI Modeling MCP Server (Public Preview).
long_description: Connects Claude to Power BI Desktop, Fabric workspaces, or PBIP/TMDL folders. Read schemas, run DAX queries, and create or modify tables, columns, measures, and relationships.

prompts.name: ConnectToPowerBIDesktop
prompts.description: Searches for the Power BI Desktop Analysis Services instance that matches the file name and connects to it.

prompts.name: ConnectToFabric
prompts.description: Connects to a semantic model in a Fabric Workspace.
prompts.text: Connect to semantic model '${arguments.semanticModelName}' in Fabric Workspace '${arguments.workspaceName}'.

prompts.name: ConnectToPBIP
prompts.description: Loads the TMDL definition from the semantic model in the Power BI Project (pbip) files.
prompts.text: Open semantic model from PBIP folder '${arguments.pbipPath}'.

prompts.name: CreateDAXQuery
prompts.description: Creates a DAX query based on your semantic model and a natural-language question.

prompts.name: RunDAXQueryWithMetrics
prompts.description: Executes a DAX query with the option to clear cache, returning execution metrics.
prompts.text:
Run this DAX query and return execution metrics (clearCache=${arguments.clearCache}):
${arguments.daxQueryText}

prompts.name: AnalyzeDAXQuery
prompts.description: Analyzes DAX query performance by running it with a cleared cache and reviewing execution metrics for potential issues.
prompts.text:
Analyze the performance of this DAX query:
${arguments.daxQueryText}
